charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% of weight + distance components)
charges.quote: carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components)

document_rules.rule: Invoice lines whose c-note number cannot be matched to a Customer booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
Payment is due 21 days from invoice date; invoices are pooled, typically fortnightly.

notes: Contract states no minimum weight, no rounding rule, no dispute window, no volume discount, and no clause declaring unlisted charges non-payable (so closed_list is false). Only standard service is offered (§2); no express premium exists. No charges are listed for fragile or residential handling.
